name: Yunipare! ~twinkle moment~
source:
Second year college student, second semester.
The protagonist and Yunipare members were invited to big events, prepared for the university art festival, and had a busy life.

Kumami, a self-proclaimed "goddess" who watches over the university, is watching over such members, but she notices that the magical power stored in Kuma Art University has been reduced by someone.
Kumami and her protagonists look for the cause ...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/2372]NovelGame[/url]]
